Species profiles of any samples as a TreeSummarizedExperiment

Source: R/metadata.R
cmgd_samples_tse.Rd

Builds a species x samples TreeSummarizedExperiment for an arbitrary set of samples, possibly from several studies, with their sample metadata as colData. Pick the samples by filtering cmgd_sample_metadata(rel, wide = TRUE), for example with dplyr::filter().

Usage

cmgd_samples_tse(rel, samples, source = names(metadata_tables),
    cache = cmgd_cache_dir())

Arguments

rel

A release from cmgd_release().

samples

sample_key values, or a data.frame with a sample_key column such as a filtered cmgd_sample_metadata(rel, wide = TRUE). Columns are in this order.

source

Which metadata table to read.

cache

Cache directory.

Value

A TreeSummarizedExperiment. metadata() has license and sources of the metadata table, as for cmgd_sample_metadata(), which also gives the attribution message for a CC-BY table. Errors naming any samples not in the release, and with class cmgdr_no_metadata if the release has no sample-metadata tables.

Details

Each sample's study comes from the release's samples table. The relative_abundance assay (sparse, percent) is built from each study's metaphlan_species.tsv.gz as in cmgd_species_tse(): rows are the union of the studies' species, 0 where a species is absent. colData is the study's qc.tsv row followed by the wide metadata columns from source (NA where a sample has no value).

Examples

if (requireNamespace("duckdb", quietly = TRUE)) {
    rel <- cmgd_release("cmgd_mpa4.2-2.3.0", release = "2026-10-16")
    meta <- cmgd_sample_metadata(rel, wide = TRUE, cache = tempdir())
    # Female cases, across studies
    picked <- meta[meta$health_condition %in% "case", ]
    picked <- picked[picked$sex %in% "female", ]
    tse <- cmgd_samples_tse(rel, picked, cache = tempdir())
    tse
    table(tse$study_name)
}
